question: A SOAP message is an XML document that is comprised of a set of pre-defined parts. Which of the following are parts that can be found in a SOAP message? (Select all that apply.) A. Envelope B. Body C. Header D. Footer

I created a WS-BPEL process definition that establishes industry standard routing-related SOAP headers capable of routing six messages. C. I created a WS-BPEL process definition that establishes an industry standard framework for issuing positive and negative acknowledgements. D. None of these statements make sense.

Which of the following statements are true? (Select all that apply.) A. A service can exist as a component. B. A service can exist as a SOAP-based Web service. C. A service can encapsulate one or more components. D. A service can encapsulate one or more SOAP-based Web services.
